note: The design screen's 3D pods (re/screens/design.md §5.1, §12, part 3): the second design (a list press), modify (the POD boxes come up as lit wireframes), a press on a pod box held: the pick (PlaySoundGlobal 2) and, after 30 ticks, the tech models open out of the pod; the pointer goes onto the first tech row and the release fits that tech (it flies into the pod, the models fold); then Esc (cancel). Times are UI ticks from the first frame the screen is up.
